enchantment.northstar_curios_compat.spac: Restores earth-like gravity on alien worlds while worn. Level I also restores earth fall damage; Level II keeps the reduced alien fall damage.
northstar_curios_compat.config.space_wal: Equipment slots that can receive the Space Walk enchantment. Requires reloading the world. Valid values: feet, legs, chest, head
Space Walk: Available in Enchanting Table
Whether the Space Walk enchantment can appear in the enchanting table. Requires reloading the world.
Space Walk: Available in Villager Trades
Whether the Space Walk enchantment can be obtained through villager trades. Requires reloading the world.
Durability consumed per second while Space Walk actively enforces earth-like gravity. Set to 0 to disable durability consumption.
